Ref.: Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and

Subject:  Audio recording for the Earnings Call held for the 2nd Quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026 for FY27 
 
Dear Sir/ Ma’am, 
 
In continuation to our letter dated October 22, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule 
III of Part A of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform that the Audio Recording of the Earnings Call 
held on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 11:30 A.M. (IST) for discussing the Company’s Financial 
Results for the 2nd quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 for FY27, has been made available 
on the Company's website. Click Here. 
 
This is for your information and record.  
 
Thanking you,  
 
Yours faithfully, 
For & on behalf of Refex Industries Limited
